monetization.title: Build an audience
monetization.summary: Income follows trust. Right now the job is a steady publishing rhythm and learning what your viewers click and keep watching.
readyWhen: You publish on a schedule you can keep
You know which of your videos brought new viewers
actions: Publish on your planned cadence for four weeks
Reply to every comment in the first 24 hours
Review click-through rate and average view duration weekly

monetization.title: Affiliate offers
monetization.summary: Recommend tools or products you really use and earn a commission. It works with a small audience because buyers are already searching.
readyWhen: Viewers ask what you use
You have videos that review, compare or teach with a product
actions: List the products you already use in your videos
Join their affiliate programs and add links to relevant descriptions
Disclose every affiliate link clearly, in the video and the description

monetization.title: Sponsorship readiness
monetization.summary: Brands pay for a defined, engaged audience, not only a big one. Prepare the proof before you pitch anyone.
readyWhen: Your views are consistent from video to video
You can describe your audience in one sentence
actions: Make a one-page media kit: audience, recent views, topics
List five brands your viewers already use
Set a simple rate you can explain

monetization.title: YouTube Partner Program
monetization.summary: Ads and memberships come through the Partner Program. Eligibility rules change, so always check the current requirements in YouTube Studio under Earn.
readyWhen: YouTube Studio shows you are close to eligibility
Your channel follows the monetization policies
actions: Open YouTube Studio > Earn and note your progress
Review the monetization policies for your niche
Keep publishing; ads add to income you already built

monetization.title: Validate the idea
monetization.summary: Before you build, check that people already ask for this and pay for similar things.
readyWhen: You found people asking for this in your niche
Similar products sell, and you know their prices
actions: Collect 10 real questions from your audience
Look at 5 similar products and their reviews
Run a quick poll or ask 3 people directly

monetization.title: Pre-sell or soft-launch
monetization.summary: A few early buyers prove the idea and pay for your time. A simple 'founding price' works well.
readyWhen: Version 1 exists, even if rough
You have a sales page with a clear promise
actions: Offer an early-bird price to people who know you
Ask early buyers what's missing
Collect one testimonial

monetization.title: Launch
monetization.summary: Tell people where they already are, with helpful content that points to your product.
readyWhen: Your sales page shows previews and a clear price
You have 3–5 posts ready
actions: Post helpful content daily for one week
Share it with your email list
Answer every question and comment

monetization.title: Grow
monetization.summary: Once it sells, improve it, add a bundle or upsell, and grow your email list.
readyWhen: You've made a handful of sales
Buyers tell you what they want next
actions: Add a bundle or a bigger version
Turn reviews into social proof
Send your list something useful every week

monetization.title: Join the right programs
monetization.summary: Pick programs for products your audience already buys, and learn each one's rules before posting links.
readyWhen: You know the 5 products your niche buys most
You've read each program's link and disclosure rules
actions: Apply to one big program and one brand program
Note commission rates and cookie windows
Add a clear disclosure template to every post

monetization.title: First commission
monetization.summary: Your first commission usually comes from a comparison or 'best for' post that answers a buying question.
readyWhen: You have 5+ published posts with links
Some posts get clicks
actions: Write one comparison post per week
Put your top pick near the top
Check which links get clicks

monetization.title: Double down
monetization.summary: Find the posts that earn and make more like them.
readyWhen: One post earns more than the rest
You know which products convert
actions: Update winning posts every month
Write related posts that link to them
Ask brands for a higher rate once you send sales

monetization.title: Diversify
monetization.summary: Don't depend on one program. Add brand partnerships, an email list and your own small product.
readyWhen: Commissions come in every month
actions: Join a second network
Grow an email list of recommendations
Test a small product of your own

monetization.title: Find your voice
monetization.summary: Know who you post for and what they get from you. Three content pillars keep you focused.
readyWhen: You can describe your audience in one sentence
You have three pillars
actions: Write your brand statement
Pick three pillars
Study 10 creators in your niche

monetization.title: Stay consistent
monetization.summary: Growth follows a schedule you can keep. Batch ideas and repurpose one idea into several posts.
readyWhen: You've posted on schedule for 2 weeks
actions: Plan a 2-week calendar
Batch-create on one day
Repurpose your best post

monetization.title: Build community
monetization.summary: Followers become a community when you talk with them. Brands notice engaged audiences, not just big ones.
readyWhen: People comment and share regularly
actions: Reply to every comment
Collaborate with a peer
Ask your audience what they want next

monetization.title: Brand deals
monetization.summary: Small brands pay for honest content and UGC. A media kit and a clear rate make you easy to say yes to.
readyWhen: You have a media kit
Your engagement is steady
actions: Make a one-page media kit
Pitch 5 small brands you already use
Always disclose paid posts with #ad or the platform's tools

onboarding.title: First things first — what's your name?
onboarding.subtitle: Just your first name. It's how I'll cheer you on.
onboarding.mascotLine: Hey! I'm Penny. I'll be with you every step.

onboarding.title: Nice to meet you, {name}! How would you like to earn?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick the one that excites you most. You can always add another later.

options.label: YouTube
options.hint: Grow your own channel, or help creators grow theirs

options.label: Affiliate content
options.hint: Earn by recommending things you love

options.label: Not sure yet
options.hint: That's okay — I'll show you what you can start today

onboarding.mascotLine: No wrong answers here, promise.

onboarding.title: YouTube, great pick! Which sounds more like you?
onboarding.subtitle: Both can work. One builds your own audience, the other helps creators who'll pay you.

options.label: I want my own channel
options.hint: Make videos, build an audience, earn over time

options.label: I want to help creators
options.hint: Get paid for clips, editing and channel help

onboarding.mascotLine: Both are great. They just feel different.

onboarding.title: What do you love talking about?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick a topic below or type your own. The more specific, the better I can help.
onboarding.mascotLine: Specific beats broad, every time.

youtube_owned_channel.title: What would your channel be about?
youtube_owned_channel.subtitle: Think of a topic you could happily talk about for months. Pick one below or type your own.

youtube_services.title: Which creators would you love to help?
youtube_services.subtitle: Think about channels you already watch. Pick a topic below or type your own.

freelance_services.title: Which kind of businesses would you like to help?
freelance_services.subtitle: Cafés, dentists, gyms, plumbers… whatever feels right to you.

digital_products.title: What could you help people with?
digital_products.subtitle: A topic you know well, even a little. Pick one below or type your own.
digital_products.placeholder: e.g. meal planning for busy parents

affiliate_content.title: What kind of products could you recommend?
affiliate_content.subtitle: Things you use, love or know a lot about. Pick one below or type your own.

creator_brand.title: What do you want to be known for?
creator_brand.subtitle: The topic people will follow you for. Pick one below or type your own.

onboarding.title: Love it! Can we zoom in a little?
onboarding.subtitle: Who exactly is it for, or what's it about? A few words is plenty.
onboarding.placeholder: e.g. busy parents who cook on a budget
onboarding.mascotLine: A little focus makes everything easier.

onboarding.title: Do you already have a YouTube channel?
onboarding.subtitle: No pressure either way — I'll skip what you've already done.

options.label: Not yet
options.hint: No worries, we'll set it up together in week 1

options.label: Yes, I've posted a few videos
options.hint: They're up, but haven't taken off yet

options.label: Yes, and it's growing
options.hint: Views and subscribers are coming in

options.label: Yes, and it already earns
options.hint: From affiliates, sponsors, products or ads

onboarding.mascotLine: Starting from zero is totally fine.

onboarding.title: How many subscribers do you have, roughly?
onboarding.subtitle: A ballpark is perfect.

options.label: 1,000 to 10,000
options.planNote: With 1,000+ subscribers, check your Partner Program progress in YouTube Studio > Earn.

options.label: 10,000 or more
options.planNote: At your size, sponsorships and your own product deserve focus alongside publishing.

onboarding.mascotLine: Every channel started at zero.

onboarding.title: What kind of videos sound fun to make?
onboarding.subtitle: Go with your gut. You can switch anytime.

options.label: Longer videos
options.planNote: Long-form first: one well-packaged video a week beats three rushed ones.

options.label: Shorts
options.hint: Under a minute, quick to make
options.planNote: Shorts-first: wherever a mission says video, make a Short; long videos are optional.

options.label: A bit of both
options.hint: One longer video, then a few Shorts from it
options.planNote: One long video a week, then cut 2–3 Shorts from it.

onboarding.mascotLine: Pick what you'd enjoy making for months.

onboarding.title: How do you feel about being on camera?
onboarding.subtitle: Lots of successful channels never show a face, so pick what feels comfortable.

options.label: Happy to be on camera
options.hint: You talk straight to your viewers

options.label: Voice only, please
options.hint: You narrate over screens, slides or footage
options.planNote: Voice-only: narrate over screen recordings, slides or b-roll; skip on-camera practice.

options.label: I'd rather stay hidden
options.hint: Text, stock footage or screen recordings
options.planNote: Faceless: on-camera tasks become screen-recording, b-roll or text tasks.

onboarding.mascotLine: Comfort matters more than gear.

onboarding.title: What would you enjoy helping creators with?
onboarding.subtitle: Pick your favorite. I'll start your plan with what creators say yes to fastest.

options.label: Cutting short clips from long videos
options.hint: The easiest first sale — your plan starts here

options.label: Editing full videos
options.planNote: Lead with a clip pack as the easy first sale, then offer full editing once a creator trusts you.

options.label: Designing thumbnails
options.planNote: Add a thumbnail sample to every pitch and sell thumbnail packs alongside your first clip pack.

options.label: Writing scripts and research
options.planNote: Use clip packs as the entry offer and pitch scripts once you know the creator's style.

options.label: Running their channel
options.planNote: Start with one clip pack, then grow into managing uploads, titles and analytics.

onboarding.mascotLine: Start small, grow later.

onboarding.title: Where would you like your clients to be?

options.label: Close to home
options.hint: Businesses in my city or area

options.label: Anywhere online

onboarding.mascotLine: Local can be a superpower.

options.label: Yes, for free
options.hint: I have work to show, just no paying clients yet

freelance_services.title: Have you helped a business before?

onboarding.title: Do you have any work you could show someone?

options.label: Not yet

onboarding.mascotLine: Showing beats telling.

options.label: I'd rather avoid it for now
options.planNote: Lead with free samples and comments before direct messages; calls stay optional.

onboarding.mascotLine: Nervous is normal. You've got this.

onboarding.title: Have you made a digital product before?
onboarding.subtitle: Anything you've created or sold counts.

options.label: Not yet
options.hint: Perfect — we'll find your idea together

options.label: I made one, but haven't sold it
options.hint: It exists, it just needs buyers

onboarding.mascotLine: Everyone's first product started as an idea.

onboarding.subtitle: Any size counts — friends, a small account, a group you're in.

options.label: I post, but no links yet
